description: In the OpenCAD dispatch system (http://localhost), log in as admin (admin@opencad.local / Admin123!). After logging in you will see the main dashboard with department buttons. Click the DISPATCH button to access the CAD Console. Click the 'New Call' button to create a new dispatch call. In the call creation form, select '10-50 | Vehicle Accident' from the Call Type dropdown, select 'Vinewood Boulevard' and 'Alta Street' from the Street dropdown menus, and write a narrative describing a three-vehicle accident with injuries requesting EMS backup. Click Send to create the call.
